comment: Advisories `npm audit --omit=dev` reports that do not reach the shipped app, each with the reason. scripts/audit-check.js fails on any other advisory; __tests__/DependencyAudit.test.js checks the reasons still hold (who depends on the package, and that the app bundle cannot load it).

advisories.why: Build tool only. Metro (the bundler) reads the project's own image assets with it on the developer's machine to record their width and height; no code in the app requires it and it is not in the JS bundle or the APK/IPA. The DoS needs a crafted JXL/HEIF image, and the only images it ever parses are the repository's own. Upgrading needs image-size 2.x, whose API Metro 0.83 does not use (it passes file paths), so the bundler would break.
Same package and reason as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq: an ICNS parsing loop in a build-time tool that parses only the repository's own assets.

Not in the app. @solana/web3.js's React Native entry (lib/index.native.js) loads only jayson/lib/client/browser, which requires nothing but uuid and jayson's generateRequest; stream-json is required by jayson/lib/utils.js, the JSON-RPC server's stream parser, which that client never loads, so Metro never bundles it. The advisory concerns stream-json's pick/ignore/filter/replace filters on hostile input, which nothing in the app runs.
